title: Withered Soul
description: A new spin on the Wither, re-doing it's textures to have a motif of soul blue and bone white.
body:
# About the pack #
This is simply a test and retexturing basic Minecraft mobs to be how I would imagine them. With this one, I have totally revamped the look of the wither in a new vanilla way as well as changed the way that withered hearts look. My inspiration for this design reflects the way that the Withers story is told in game through subtle hints in carvings on walls, and so I designed it to be this tribal creation with the motifs of soul blue and bone white throughout the texture reflecting it's creation of wither skeleton and soul blocks.

Hope you enjoy this pack, I really did enjoy making the texture for it and learning more generally about retexturing mobs from the base game.

# Rules with the pack #
These models/textures are not free to be taken, this is my pack with models/testures made exclusively by me and my imagination. These models/textures are free to be used as a texture pack in videos and such, however editing of this pack is not allowed. These are not your creations. <3
